title: Isolation Demo run.sh
description: Bash script that runs the container with strict isolation: read-only filesystem, dropped capabilities, PID limit, memory limit, and single folder mount.

steps.description: Complete run.sh script for container execution.
Shebang and setup: bash interpreter, usage comment, set -euo pipefail for error handling.
Directory: cd to script directory for consistent path resolution.
Network option: NET=none sets --network none flag for no internet access.
Security flags: --read-only filesystem, tmpfs for /tmp and /home/bun, --cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges.
Resource limits: --pids-limit 256 and --memory 1g constrain the container.
Mount and execution: user mapping, environment variables, volume mount workspace:/workspace, working directory.
